beats.text: The bookshop was closing for good.
At 9 PM, a girl in a school uniform was still in the corner, reading.
"We're closing, beta." She didn't look up. "Can I finish this chapter?"
At midnight she asked, "Who decides when a shop's story ends?"
Mr. Rao took the closing sign off the door.

end.text: Would you have kept it open?
